messages.author: 1c86933485a3473e
messages.subject: 2DAR1 in RTMB vs TMB
parts:
Hi,

I am currently trying to replicate some TMB code in RTMB. However, I can't figure out how exactly a two-dimensional separable autoregressive process might be replicated in RTMB. I am specifically interesting in replicating the nLL calculations. Any pointers?

Thanks!

Below is the TMB version:

// Set up containers and calculate process errors
    array<Type> eps_at(ln_Y_at.rows(), ln_Y_at.cols()); // array of process errors
    eps_at = ln_Y_at - log(mu_at); // process errors relative to the mean across age and time
   
    // Get sigma for 2dar1
    Type trans_rho_y = rho_trans(rho_y);
    Type trans_rho_a = rho_trans(rho_a);
   
    Type Sigma = pow(exp(log_sigma2) / ((1-pow(trans_rho_y,2))*(1-pow(trans_rho_a,2))),0.5);
    nLL_gmrf += SCALE(SEPARABLE(AR1(trans_rho_a),AR1(trans_rho_y)), Sigma)(eps_at);

messages.author: 1c86933485a3473e
messages.subject: Re: 2DAR1 in RTMB vs TMB
parts:
Following up with a solution:

        # Define 2d unit variance
        unit_var = sqrt(sigma2) / sqrt(1 - rho_y^2) / sqrt(1 - rho_a^2)
       
        # Define ar1 separable functions
        f1 = function(x) dautoreg(x, mu = 0, phi = rho_y, log = TRUE)
        f2 = function(x) dautoreg(x, mu = 0, phi = rho_a, log = TRUE)
        ll = ll + RTMB::dseparable(f1, f2)(eps_ya, scale = unit_var)

Thanks Chris Cahill for pointing me in the right direction!
